lines.text: Hi! I'm Clover. I grow things.
A little water, a little sunshine…

beats.action: Clover talks to the camera with a friendly little wave of her trowel.
She kneels down beside the garden bed in front of her, still smiling at the camera.
Clover looks at the camera and talks softly in a sing-song way while sprinkling a handful of seeds onto the soil of the garden bed beside her.
She stops talking, kneels and gently taps the soil twice with her trowel, smiling.
Clover looks up at the camera with a little secret smile and says: "…and… look what happens!" pointing down at the soil.
A whole row of sunflowers, carrots, tomatoes and daisies springs up around her in a rippling wave; her ears perk straight up and she gives a tiny happy clap.
Clover looks straight at the camera among the new flowers and says: "We can fix anything!" with a little thumbs-up.
She holds a big happy grin and gives a small wave, staying in place.

video.description: CLOVER the soft white rabbit with long floppy ears wears green overalls with a carrot in the pocket and holds a tiny trowel, in a sunny vegetable garden.
